newsitem.title: SWEDEN: S&P assigns AA+ rating to Dexia Kommunbank AB.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns AA+ rating to Dexia Kommunbank AB.

text.p: U.S. credit rating agency Standard & Poor's said on Thursday that it had assigned a longterm credit rating of AA+ to Dexia Kommunbank AB with the outlook stable.
Dexia Kommunbank's parent company is Credit Local de France.
"The outlook for Dexia Kommunbank's long-term rating is a direct reflection of the stable outlook for the parent bank, CLF," S&P said.

"S&P expects CLF to be able to cope with the tough competition that is putting pressure on its margins. Dexia's expanded capital base and funding resources should help CLF to resist increasing competition after economic and monetary union."
S&P also assigned Dexia Kommunbank AB a short-term credit rating of A-1+ and a Swedish commercial paper rating of K-1.
Dexia Kommunbank is a wholly owned Swedish subsidiary of CLF and provides long term funding to regional and local governments in Sweden.
